summary.headline: Astrological Inceptions and Chronocratories
summary.text: Catalog entries for astrological chapters on planetary chronocratories, annual and monthly inceptions, the royal lot, conjunctions and full moons, eclipses, planetary states, rains, and harms to the Moon and stars. Authorities cited include Theophilus, Nechepso, Julian, and a Syrian source, with references to Florentine codex 12 and Marcianum 335.
